title: Harbison Flat-Rate Price Book, 2026-03 Edition — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
Every repair on a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls is billed from this price book under the task code of the repair. Each task has a parts amount and a labor amount. The labor amount shown is before the call class's labor multiplier.

| Task | Parts amount | Labor amount (before class multiplier) |
|---|---|---|
| Capacitor replace | $96.00 | $153.00 |
| Contactor replace | $84.00 | $165.00 |
| Condenser fan motor replace | $289.00 | $346.00 |
| Blower motor replace | $342.00 | $387.00 |
| ECM blower motor replace | $868.00 | $461.00 |
| Inducer motor replace | $412.00 | $377.00 |
| Igniter replace | $74.00 | $165.00 |
| Flame sensor service | $18.00 | $121.00 |
| Pressure switch replace | $89.00 | $176.00 |
| Control board replace | $386.00 | $289.00 |
| Gas valve replace | $312.00 | $341.00 |
| TXV replace | $196.00 | $689.00 |
| Evaporator coil replace | $1180.00 | $1145.00 |
| Condenser coil replace | $1340.00 | $1260.00 |
| Compressor replace | $1640.00 | $1585.00 |
| Reversing valve replace | $287.00 | $1093.00 |
| Defrost board replace | $268.00 | $247.00 |
| Refrigerant leak search | $0.00 | $349.00 |
| Condensate drain clear | $0.00 | $159.00 |
| Condensate pump replace | $126.00 | $163.00 |
| Thermostat replace | $189.00 | $140.00 |
| Duct cleaning, whole home | $0.00 | $589.00 |

## Major repairs

Five tasks are major repairs: compressor replace, evaporator coil replace, condenser coil replace, reversing valve replace and TXV replace.

## Reading the book

- A task with a parts amount of $0.00 has no parts amount. The refrigerant leak search, condensate drain clear and whole-home duct cleaning are billed as labor only.
- Refrigerant added during a repair is not in this book. It is billed by the pound from the refrigerant price list.

## Hypothetical lookups

- A capacitor replacement on a Standard Service Call carries parts of $96.00 and labor of $153.00, because the Standard multiplier is 1.0.
- A flame sensor service on an Evening Service Call carries parts of $18.00 and labor of $121.00 multiplied by 1.25, which is $151.25.
